HOME-T-E02.proved: A hint arriving during initial GET survives the older response; reconnect/live/gap during an active GET queues one serial snapshot read and does not reuse an old page cursor.
HOME-T-E02.limit: Public controller entry points called by the hook are exercised; actual React effect scheduling, SSE subscription/retention transport and browser reconnect are not executed. Convergence is proved, not a stronger action-freshness fence during the intermediate old response.

cases: E03 duplicate and out-of-order hints cannot replay activity states over newer canonical snapshots
HOME-T-E03.proved: Duplicate and out-of-order hints coalesce; accepted/running/terminal snapshots replace one stable activity and one result without hint-driven regression. Reads remain serial.
HOME-T-E03.limit: Canonical GET responses advance or retain committed state in the fixture. This does not certify server replica monotonicity or arbitrary regressing response bodies.

cases: E05 a continuously live stream does not renew external TTL or replace stale reported work with native activity
HOME-T-E05.proved: A coherent two-second external deadline triggers GET despite continuously live stream; the returned stale external observation retains unknown-state/report provenance and does not change native work/results.
HOME-T-E05.limit: Clock and API response are deterministic fixtures. The real backend expiration and visual badge rendering are separate existing evidence, not executed here.

acceptance: Root owns ledger status. Four tests do not automatically qualify whole scenarios or all73 cases. Frozen package/candidate remain unchanged.
